classification.difficultyReason: Find the gain in house value, select the purchase price as the reference whole, and convert the gain-to-original ratio to an exact percentage.

content.prompt: A house was bought for $\$300\,000$ in 2000. It was sold again in 2005 for $\$475\,000$. What was the percentage increase in the value of the house?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Increase in value}&=475\,000-300\,000\\\text{Increase in value}&=175\,000\end{align*}$$
The increase was $\$175\,000$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage increase}&=\frac{175\,000}{300\,000}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage increase}&=\frac{175}{3}\%\\\text{Percentage increase}&=58\frac{1}{3}\%\end{align*}$$
